2ae980e285d09b37.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Quality Inspector to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on ensuring the quality of installed accessories in vehicles within the PIO operation. The Quality Inspector will verify that accessories meet specified standards for function and appearance, ensuring they are suitable for customer use according to designed procedures. Key Responsibilities Perform quality inspections at designated checkpoints, including final inspection, as per defined procedures. Conduct random inspections to ensure consistent quality. Complete inspection check sheets in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs). Execute NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness) testing. Ensure timely data entry in JSAP for production fulfillment and customer deliveries. Register billing in JSAP for each accessory label. Report inspection findings, non-conformities, and daily QC results, communicating inspection status and adhering to standard QC procedures. Escalate critical quality issues, major non-conformities, or recurring defects that require management attention. Submit inspection records, Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and checklists to maintain accurate quality documentation and traceability. Share inspection techniques, clarify standards, coordinate workload, and manage the handover of inspection activities. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in quality inspection. Demonstrated ability to organize, plan, and monitor operations related to dispatch. Proficiency in performing quality inspections as per defined procedures. Experience with data entry systems like JSAP. Work Environment and Coordination The role involves close coordination with other Vehicle Logistics Department (VLD) functions, including the planning and inventory management department, to ensure efficient and effective execution of plans. The Quality Inspector will operate in a dynamic environment focused on maintaining high-quality standards for vehicle accessories.

2afd5926a3844d74.description: About the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an experienced Engineer - MV and LV to join its Engineering team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Participating in the improvement of maintenance procedures for MV substations, transformers, and switchgears. Detecting the origin of breakdowns, establishing diagnostics, and analyzing root causes of electrical installation failures. Advising and training users on equipment and updating technical data. Implementing maintenance plans for transformers, capacitors, insulators, lightning arrestors, switches, circuit breakers, and other medium-voltage distribution equipment. 2a726febbe8e8a0f.description: About Medtronic Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology, committed to alleviating pain, restoring health, and extending life. 2acf716331356086.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a QC Inspector – Dimensional to join their team in Al Jubail. This contract role is responsible for ensuring the dimensional accuracy of castings and forgings against stringent customer specifications and engineering drawings. The inspector will play a critical role in maintaining quality control throughout various stages of the casting process, with a focus on dimensional inspection, documentation, and non-conformance resolution. Interpret engineering drawings, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), and apply relevant ISO, ASME, and ASTM standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in dimensional inspection, preferably within the casting and forging industry. Demonstrated ability to interpret engineering drawings, including Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T). Proficiency in applying ISO 8062 standards and other relevant ISO, ASME, and ASTM standards for dimensional and visual inspection. Experience in operating and maintaining dimensional inspection equipment. Strong understanding of quality documentation, non-conformance reporting, and corrective action processes. The role requires a meticulous approach to quality control and a commitment to ensuring product dimensions meet exact customer requirements.

2a67c5cc59a54c5b.description: About the Role Talents First is recruiting on behalf of a major international industrial group that is expanding its presence in Saudi Arabia through a strategic industrial partnership. We are seeking an experienced Product Configuration & Master Data Management Engineer to support the industrialisation of configurable products and integrate engineering, commercial, and manufacturing processes through SAP and connected enterprise systems. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern Province, and reports to the Head of Process and Systems. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining and optimising product configuration models in SAP Variant Configuration (LO-VC) and CPQ, while ensuring the accuracy and consistency of material master data across integrated platforms. This role combines technical configuration expertise, industrial process understanding, and cross-functional collaboration, directly contributing to product data integrity, configuration performance, and manufacturing efficiency. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and optimise SAP VC models, translating engineering specifications and industrial processes into configuration rules, characteristics, classes, and object dependencies. Maintain and validate CPQ product models, ensuring consistency between commercial configuration requirements and industrial production processes. Manage the creation, maintenance, and extension of SAP Material Master Data (MM), ensuring accuracy, integrity, and alignment with industrialisation requirements. Coordinate with product configuration developers and PLM specialists to maintain consistent product data across CPQ, SAP ERP, PLM, and MES environments, including connected systems such as Windchill, Configit, and TDC. Test and validate configuration changes across SAP environments, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and troubleshoot configuration issues affecting industrialisation and production. Identify opportunities to improve configuration performance, data quality, automation, and the reliability of system interfaces. Collaborate with procurement teams to define and automate the transfer of relevant product characteristics and pricing information from variant configuration into supplier purchase orders. Prepare technical documentation, provide training on configuration models and master data processes, and support internal stakeholders in resolving configuration-related challenges. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in product configuration and master data management. Demonstrated expertise in SAP Variant Configuration (LO-VC) and CPQ. Strong understanding of industrial processes and their integration with enterprise systems. Experience with SAP Material Master Data (MM) management. Familiarity with PLM, MES, and connected systems such as Windchill, Configit, and TDC. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, within a major international industrial group expanding its operations in the region. The role involves cross-functional collaboration with various teams. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

2a6919b8fe7cf616.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فاينكيور كولكشن سوليشنز عن فني عمليات تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم وتنفيذ الخطط المتعلقة بعمليات تقنية المعلومات، وتقديم المساعدة الفنية اللازمة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطبيق وتنفيذ الخطط الفنية المتعلقة بعمليات تقنية المعلومات، والالتزام بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات المطلوبة لعمليات تقنية المعلومات، ورفع النواقص إلى المعنيين لتأمينها. تقديم المساعدة الفنية لمهندس وأخصائي تقنية المعلومات في أداء مهامهم واختصاصاتهم، وتنفيذ المهام الموكلة إليه. حفظ البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بكافة عمليات تقنية المعلومات الفنية، والعمل على تبويبها وترتيبها وفقاً للممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بتقنية المعلومات. القدرة على تطبيق وتنفيذ الخطط الفنية. مهارات جيدة في تحديد الاحتياجات وتأمين المستلزمات. القدرة على تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة. مهارات تنظيمية لحفظ البيانات وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل فني عمليات تقنية المعلومات ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة فاينكيور كولكشن سوليشنز بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عملنا.

2a565b6b194882f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرأي للخدمات البيئية عن أخصائي إدارة قواعد بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب إدارة قواعد البيانات، من التصميم والتركيب إلى الصيانة وحل المشكلات، لضمان كفاءة وسلامة البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل المخططات والرسومات والمواصفات الفنية ومحددات قواعد البيانات. تحديد وتطوير السياسات والمعايير الخاصة بإدارة قواعد البيانات. تركيب قواعد البيانات وتحديد نوع وحجم الحقول والجداول ضمنها. إنشاء جداول البيانات والروابط، وإجراء الفحوصات الدورية لقواعد البيانات. إعداد أدلة التوثيق الشاملة لقواعد البيانات. تركيب وتجهيز نظم إدارة قواعد البيانات. حل مشاكل الاتصال بقواعد البيانات لضمان استمرارية العمل. وضع خطط النسخ الاحتياطي ومتابعة تنفيذ عمليات النسخ الاحتياطي للبيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة قواعد البيانات. فهم عميق لمفاهيم تصميم قواعد البيانات وهيكلتها. القدرة على تحليل المتطلبات الفنية وتطبيقها في بيئة قواعد البيانات. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

2ab1783ed414988d.description: About Calo Inc. Calo, launched in Bahrain in November 2019, aims to simplify healthy eating by providing accessible food options through technology. The company is seeking an Assistant Quality Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Assistant Quality Manager will support the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of food safety and quality management systems. This full-time role focuses on ensuring that products, processes, and kitchen operations consistently meet regulatory requirements, customer specifications, and company standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in food safety and quality assurance within the food and beverage industry, preferably in central kitchen or large-scale food production operations. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Food Safety and Quality Management System, including HACCP, GMPs, SOPs, ISO 22000, and FSSC 22000. Ensure daily kitchen and production operations comply with established food safety procedures, quality standards, and local regulations. Conduct routine internal audits and inspections to assess compliance with food safety, hygiene, and quality standards. Support preparations for regulatory, certification, and third-party audits, ensuring required documentation and records are maintained. Conduct and monitor quality checks across raw materials, food preparation, cooking, storage, packaging, and finished products. Investigate quality-related incidents, customer complaints, and product non-conformances, performing root cause analysis and recommending corrective actions. Support the Quality Manager in coordinating and supervising the day-to-day activities of the local quality team. Conduct food safety and quality training sessions for employees. Support supplier approval and monitoring processes, including reviewing documentation and conducting assessments. Maintain accurate and up-to-date food safety and quality records and assist in analyzing quality data. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in food safety and quality assurance within the food and beverage industry, preferably in central kitchen, catering, or large-scale food production operations. Previous experience in a supervisory or team leadership role is preferred. Experience conducting internal audits, investigating non-conformances, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Hands-on experience with quality control procedures, product inspections, and food safety monitoring. Certifications in food safety management, auditing, or other relevant disciplines are an advantage. Lean Six Sigma (LSS) experience is a plus. Required Knowledge and Competencies Strong understanding of food safety principles, HACCP, GMPs, and quality assurance practices. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify practical solutions. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify potential food safety risks. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ability to take ownership of day-to-day quality issues, follow through on corrective actions, and escalate significant risks when necessary. A proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, consumer safety, and product quality. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with kitchen, production, procurement, and operations teams to maintain high standards of food safety and product quality.

2a1fb0719f302505.description: About the Role Amazon is seeking a Last Mile Logistics Sr. Account Manager for Quick Commerce MEA TR Delivery Service Partners. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role focuses on driving innovation in the transportation industry, empowering entrepreneurs, and contributing to Amazon’s sustainability goals within the quick commerce business (15-minute and 2-hour delivery). Role Overview The Sr. Account Manager will lead a team of managers to oversee Delivery Service Partner (DSP) accounts, guiding business owners through the growth of their middle-mile logistics operations. This position involves managing DSP relationships across the business lifecycle, acting as a trusted advisor to solve challenges, influence business planning, and identify obstacles to ensure effective decision-making and success for DSP owners. Key Responsibilities Manage a team of 6+ managers overseeing 80+ DSP accounts in Saudi Arabia, including entrepreneurs new to logistics and seasoned carriers. Work with a portfolio of owners at various stages to set strategy, drive accountability and engagement, and track key performance metrics. Collaborate with internal Program Managers, Compliance, and Finance personnel to ensure business launches and scaling adhere to program requirements. Support owners by addressing obstacles and enhancing financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. Analyze problems, derive insights, provide recommendations, and implement changes both internally and externally. Engage with internal stakeholders such as Partner Relations, Value Added Service, Legal, fleet, and network health teams. Facilitate and execute Monitoring and Enforcement Policies (MEP) and establish feedback channels with OTR teams, DSPs, and WW/EU Product and strategy. Travel between multiple sites weekly to engage with business owners effectively. Operational Focus Areas Safety: Partner with OTR Safety and Regional Managers to ensure business safety compliance. Performance: Guide owners in scaling operations, managing issues, preparing for peak periods, and onboarding. Coach on AMZL tools, identify customer metric improvement opportunities, and champion Last Mile processes. Experience: Identify workflow inefficiencies, implement operational improvements, enhance the Amazon-DSP relationship, align communication, and represent DSP interests within AMZL. Capacity Management: Work with DSPs to develop ramp plans and pipeline goals to meet driver supply for peak volume demands. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 2a47a8c8fe9224e8.description: About Galderma Galderma is a dermatology category leader operating in approximately 90 countries. The company offers a science-based portfolio of brands and services across Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare, and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since its founding in 1981, Galderma has focused on skin health, addressing consumer and patient needs in partnership with healthcare professionals. The company is dedicated to advancing dermatology for various skin conditions. The Role of Medical Science Liaison (Dermatology) Galderma is seeking a Medical Science Liaison (Dermatology) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves advancing scientific standards of care, enhancing Galderma's scientific credibility with key thought leaders (KTLs/KOLs), and facilitating medical-scientific projects. The Medical Science Liaison acts as a point of contact for KTLs/KOLs and supports local and global medical teams. Key Responsibilities Advance science and standards of care for patients and healthcare providers. Enhance Galderma's scientific credibility with established and emerging national and regional KTLs/KOLs. Act as the point of contact with KTLs/KOLs to facilitate medical-scientific projects and requests for support to local and global medical teams. Identify, develop, and maintain contact with local, regional, and national KTLs/KOLs and experts through approved field engagement plans. Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with KTLs/KOLs and academic centers to ensure access to current medical and scientific information. Ensure KTLs/KOLs can access relevant information and solutions for Galderma’s products. Communicate information about Galderma’s compounds in development in a scientific, non-promotional manner, adhering to regulations and policies. Organize and implement advisory boards independently and plan, contact, and brief speakers for scientific symposia. Carry out and support sales force education and training courses. Deliver scientific and medical slide kits to physicians, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders. Attend relevant scientific meetings and conferences and support scientific dialogue and collaborations. Produce, review, and update approved scientific presentations for assigned therapeutic areas as needed. Maintain a high level of scientific knowledge for credible dissemination of information and dialogue with KOLs/KTLs. Gather actionable insights through congress attendance, stakeholder engagement, and scientific literature review. Ensure close interdepartmental cooperation with medical office staff and relevant marketing & sales teams. Support internal teams in developing scientific expertise through update presentations. Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with other in-field members while retaining functional independence. Communicate and interact with the Global and International Medical Affairs teams. Serve as a point of contact within the Medical Affairs Team for KTLs/KOLs within KSA. Participate in the selection process to identify qualified thought leaders for collaborative efforts. Ensure all activities and interactions comply with applicable local, global, and national laws, regulations, and Galderma’s policies. Support Galderma research by identifying investigators and providing feedback to medical and clinical teams. Respond to unsolicited requests for medical and scientific information. Utilize modern technology platforms to maximize efficiency and effectiveness. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, including the Code of Conduct. Candidate Profile Candidates for this role should be results-oriented, embrace learning, and bring positive energy. They should combine initiative with teamwork and collaboration, demonstrating a commitment to making a meaningful impact for consumers, patients, and healthcare professionals. The role requires individuals who can contribute to advancing dermatology. Work Environment and Culture Galderma fosters an environment that empowers employees and promotes personal growth while meeting business needs. The company embraces diversity and respects the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee. Professionalism, collaboration, and a supportive ethos are central to the work culture, aiming to enable individuals to thrive and excel.

2ad14388ee255606.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة آدم الطبية عن صيدلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويركز على دراسة وتحضير التركيبات الدوائية، وإدارة مخزون الصيدلية، وصرف الأدوية للمرضى مع تقديم الإرشادات اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والمواد الصيدلانية، وتحضيرها وصرفها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية. تحديد الآثار الجانبية المحتملة لاستخدام الأدوية وتأثيراتها على الإنسان. تقييم احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والعلاجات وتحديد أنواعها وكمياتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد وتدقيق طلبات الشراء، ومتابعة توفير واستلام وتخزين الأدوية وفقاً لسجلات المخزون والأسس الصيدلانية. دراسة الوصفات الطبية وتجهيز الدواء قبل صرفه للمستهلك، وتقديم الإرشادات للمريض حول طريقة الاستعمال والآثار الجانبية المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات المستمرة في مجال الصيدلة. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالصيدلة في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال الصيدلة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصيدلة. القدرة على دراسة التركيبات الدوائية وتحضيرها بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات تخزين الأدوية وصرفها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل لتقديم الإرشادات للمرضى. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة في بيئة العمل الصيدلانية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة آدم الطبية في بريدة، القصيم، ويتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية في بيئة صيدلانية ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

2a5674be6e55d959.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالعزيز عبيد المطيري عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية وتنظيم المراسلات والمواعيد، بالإضافة إلى تنسيق الاجتماعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على الأقسام المعنية. متابعة البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقاً لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية. تنظيم وحفظ الملفات والمعاملات بطريقة تسهل الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها. طباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية في إدارة البريد والمواعيد. إتقان التعامل مع مهام الطباعة والرد على الاستفسارات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. القدرة على تنظيم الملفات والمعاملات بكفاءة. مهارات تنسيق الاجتماعات وتدوين المحاضر. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق يدعم العمليات الإدارية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

2a9029f188fd6d10.description: ✅ الشروط الأساسية: * أن يكون المتقدم متواجدًا حاليًا داخل المملكة العربية السعودية وجاهزًا لنقل الكفالة. * خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 3 سنوات ولا تزيد عن 5 سنوات في مكاتب المراجعة الخارجية تحديدًا. * الوظيفة مخصصة للمراجعين الخارجيين الذين سبق لهم العمل في مكاتب المراجعة والمحاسبة المهنية، وليست للمحاسبين الذين تقتصر خبرتهم على العمل داخل الشركات. * الإلمام الجيد بالمعايير الدولية للتقرير المالي (IFRS) ومعايير المراجعة ذات الصلة. * القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المراجعة وإعداد أوراق العمل، وفحص القوائم المالية، وتقييم الرقابة الداخلية. * الدقة في العمل، والالتزام بالمواعيد، والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. 🎯 مميزات الوظيفة: * بيئة عمل مهنية تساعد على تطوير الخبرات الفنية والعملية. * فرصة لاكتساب خبرة أعمق في أعمال المراجعة الخارجية والتعامل مع عملاء من قطاعات مختلفة. * فريق عمل متعاون وفرص للتطور المهني. * راتب يتم تحديده بعد المقابلة الشخصية وفقًا للخبرة والكفاءة. 🕘 مواعيد العمل: من الأحد إلى الخميس، من الساعة 9:00 صباحًا حتى 6:00 مساءً. 📍 مقر العمل: مدينة الخبر، المملكة العربية السعودية.

2a48f675423e6c41.description: About Mace Group Mace Group integrates construction expertise with consultancy services to enhance project potential and redefine ambitious goals. The company's values guide its consulting approach and define the professionals it seeks to join its team. Mace is committed to fostering a safe, diverse, and inclusive work environment, prioritizing well-being, client focus, integrity, and continuous opportunity for its people. The Opportunity: Senior Planning Manager Mace Group is seeking a Senior Planning Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This part-time role involves working on one of Saudi Arabia's largest programs, a significant mixed-use development that includes sports facilities, entertainment, arts, and associated infrastructure. As a delivery partner, Mace requires experienced professionals to lead integrated teams throughout the project phases. Key Responsibilities Manage project planning in accordance with contractual requirements, employer, and engineer objectives and procedures. Establish project milestones and review work activities to ensure alignment with these milestones. Coordinate, collect, verify, and integrate contract work scope from all entities into the overall project plan, reviewing scope representation in schedules. Identify schedule constraints and their impact on the total project schedule, collaborating with departments and chairing interdisciplinary workshops to resolve issues. Review and evaluate schedule durations for all discipline activities relative to project milestones. Perform forensic schedule analysis for disputes/claims and study problem areas to determine schedule activity criticality, recommending alternatives for schedule improvement. Define and present the Schedule Impact Report, leading the development and review of schedule recovery plans, including resource evaluation. Monitor and report on the critical path and overall schedule performance of the project. Issue reports as required by the employer and project procedures, ensuring consistency with previous reports. Qualifications and Requirements Extensive experience in construction and project planning using Primavera Project Management software. Significant experience with large, complex projects during both design and construction phases. Ability to meet necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Relevant work experience on high-value projects/programs for a project management consultancy business, required for immigration and client approval. Commitment to Diversity Mace is an inclusive employer and encourages applications from a diverse range of candidates. 2aeab1734a86c57f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايفارا للهندسة عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للمهندسين المعماريين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية لاكتساب خبرة عملية في التصميم المعماري والدعم الفني، بالإضافة إلى التنسيق بين التخصصات الهندسية المختلفة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل. سياق الوظيفة يتعاون المهندس المعماري في هذا الدور مع أصحاب الخبرة لإعداد التصاميم التفصيلية وسير العمل باستخدام نمذجة معلومات البناء (BIM). كما يشارك في مراجعة الرسومات التنفيذية والتعامل مع متطلبات المشاريع في قطاعات مثل الرعاية الصحية والمشاريع التجارية. المهام والمسؤوليات المساعدة في إعداد الرسومات المعمارية التفصيلية والمخططات الوظيفية والرسومات التنفيذية تحت إشراف المهندسين ذوي الخبرة. التعاون مع فرق الهندسة الإنشائية والميكانيكية والكهربائية والصحية (MEP) والتصميم الداخلي لضمان توافق النماذج الفنية ومخرجات المشاريع. المساعدة في مراجعة وإدارة واستخدام النماذج والمستندات الصادرة للتنفيذ (IFC)، والتأكد من دقتها قبل البدء في التنفيذ بالموقع. المساعدة في إعداد مستندات المناقصات المعمارية ومراجعة جداول الكميات (BOQ) والمواصفات الفنية وملفات التقييم الفني. التعرف على كود البناء السعودي (SBC) واللوائح البلدية المحلية وتطبيقها، بالإضافة إلى إرشادات السلامة وسهولة الوصول. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. الموهبة والدقة في التفاصيل. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق شركة ايفارا في المنطقة الشرقية، الهفوف، في بيئة داعمة تتيح له اكتساب الخبرة العملية والتطور المهني. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

The role ensures data products meet governance, operational resilience, and performance standards to support business intelligence, analytics, and decision-making. The position also provides technical leadership to enhance engineering consistency, operational reliability, and long-term platform sustainability. Maintain engineering practices that ensure consistency, reusability, and long-term maintainability of data solutions. Strengthen trust in enterprise data through robust validation, reconciliation, testing, and quality control mechanisms. Ensure metadata, lineage, and discoverability requirements are embedded across all data assets and pipelines. Enable governed access to curated datasets that support enterprise-wide data consumption. Optimize pipeline efficiency, scalability, and operational performance through continuous tuning and workload optimization. Improve production stability through monitoring, alerting, incident management, and proactive risk mitigation. Reduce operational disruptions by enhancing reliability, restartability, and recovery capabilities. Provide technical guidance that enhances engineering quality, consistency, and delivery excellence. Develop reusable components, standards, and engineering playbooks that improve productivity and reduce complexity. Influence technical decisions that strengthen enterprise data engineering capabilities. Partner with data modelers, governance teams, platform specialists, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated data solutions. Ensure engineering outputs align with enterprise data definitions, governance requirements, and business needs. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance cost efficiency, operability, and solution effectiveness. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in engineering and ETL enterprise roles. Performance Indicators Consistent delivery of trusted, accurate, and timely data products via enterprise data pipelines. Proactive identification and efficient resolution of data quality issues with clear ownership. Continuous optimization of pipeline performance and operational costs without compromising reliability. Discoverability and governance of data assets, supported by accurate metadata and lineage. Reduction of production incidents through strong engineering practices, monitoring, and operational excellence. Improvement in delivery speed, quality, and scalability across initiatives through engineering standards and reusable assets. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to the development of Saudi Arabia's mining industry.

2a28d24aeb761915.description: About Mozn MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact. If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises. About the role We're hiring an AI Senior SRE: someone who carries a normal SRE workload — on-call rotation, incident response, root cause analysis, hands-on Kubernetes/cloud work — and builds the agentic layer that automates that workload over time. You are not exempt from operating production. You're the person best placed to know what should be automated, because you're the one doing it. This role exists because most reliability toil (triage, root-causing, remediation, SLO tracking, onboarding checks) is repetitive and well-defined enough to hand to an LLM-based agent with the right guardrails. Your job is to do the on-call/ops work like any SRE, then turn what you learn into agents — identify the workflow, build the agent, and earn the trust to let it act with increasing autonomy. What you'll do Carry a normal on-call rotation and act as a hands-on responder: investigate, fix, and document incidents yourself, exactly like any SRE on the team — especially for workflows that don' t have an agent yet. Go deep on application-level reliability, not just infrastructure: read and debug service code, understand business logic well enough to find the real root cause, and ship fixes or PRs directly into application repos when the fix belongs in the app, not the platform. Design, build, and ship LLM-based agents (using tools like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3) that plug into our existing stack: Kubernetes, cloud APIs, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Datadog, PagerDuty/Slack. Define the "tool" interface each agent needs — the specific APIs, scripts, and read/write actions — and build safe wrappers around them. Set clear guardrails for every agent: what it may do autonomously vs. what it must propose for human approval, with a bias toward human-in-the-loop until an agent has earned trust. Own agent evaluation — define what "correct" and "safe" look like per agent, and build test/backtest suites against real historical incidents. Continuously tune prompts, context, and tool schemas as an agent' s scope grows. Partner with the SRE/platform team to find good agent candidates: repetitive, well-scoped, auditable workflows. Report on agent impact — MTTD/MTTR/MTTX movement, false positive/negative rates, and engineer-hours of toil removed. Keep a security- and compliance-first posture: audit trails for every autonomous action, least-privilege access to production, and alignment with Saudi data residency/regulatory requirements. Requirements 3+ years building production software with LLMs — agentic workflows, tool/function calling, multi-step planning, RAG — not just personal use of a chat assistant. Hands-on experience shipping real work with an agentic coding tool such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3. Strong Python (or similar) for building agent tooling, API wrappers, and orchestration. Real, hands-on SRE experience: comfortable being a primary on-call responder, running incident response, and doing root cause analysis under pressure — not just familiar with the concepts. Application-level debugging skill, not just infra: able to read a service' s codebase, trace a failure back to the actual line/logic causing it, and ship a fix yourself — SRE work here isn' t limited to restarting pods or scaling nodes. Solid hands-on Kubernetes and cloud provider experience (AWS/GCP/OCI/Azure) and fluency with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK) — both as an operator and as integration points for agents. Understands guardrails for autonomous systems: permissioning, approval gates, rollback paths, auditability. Can build trust with technical stakeholders — every agent starts with limited autonomy and has to earn more. Nice to have Experience in Saudi Arabia / MENA, ideally consulting across public or private sector clients. Familiarity with Terraform/Ansible, Docker, VM/on-prem setups — useful context for the agents you' ll build, not the core job. Experience building eval/backtest harnesses for LLM agents against historical incident data. Background in ML engineering, LLMOps, or platform engineering. Benefits You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves
